verdict.insufficient: There is not yet enough measured data to give a verdict on this cell.

figure.insufficientHint: No value: the available data is not enough to compute it.
figure.noObservations: No single observation is linked to this figure.

market.national: National data: the trend covers the whole country, not the city.
market.chartSummary: From {first} to {last} nominal value goes from {nominalFrom} to {nominalTo}; volume (value at constant prices) from {volumeFrom} to {volumeTo}. They are two distinct series: nominal value and volume must not be confused.
market.insufficient: There are not enough years of measured data to compute the national trend for this category. Missing data is not a low score: the cell stays out of the rankings.
market.ruleExpanding: Real value {real} a year and volume {volume} a year ({period}): real growth above the expansion threshold and volume not falling.
market.ruleThreatened: Real value {real} a year and volume {volume} a year ({period}): at least one of them falls beyond the threat threshold.
market.ruleConsolidated: Real value {real} a year and volume {volume} a year ({period}): between the thresholds, a consolidated market.
market.ruleInsufficient: Fewer than three consecutive years of data, only exploratory signals, or no statistical class for this category.

territory.missingHint: Data not available: the factor stays neutral (1).
territory.production: Value produced in the territory is not used as consumption.
territory.insufficient: Without national spend and population there is no local demand estimate. Missing data does not become a zero.

consumers.insufficient: The CSI is only published with at least 50 valid mentions. Below that threshold we show an insufficient data state, not a low score.
consumers.neverSample: Online sentiment is never a representative sample of consumers: it describes who writes online, not the population.
consumers.attentionNote: These are interest signals, not demand: they say how much something is discussed or searched, not how much is bought.
consumers.provenanceNote: The relevant mentions behind this reading, by source. Excerpts carry no author identifiers.
consumers.provenanceNone: No source recorded for this reading.
consumers.scoredWith: Classified by {model}, prompt {prompt}. The model classifies; the index is computed in code.

competition.assortmentNote: Coverage of a crowd-sourced database, not market size.
competition.assortmentEmpty: No assortment counts available for this category.
competition.offersEmpty: No products observed for this category and country.
competition.noPrices: The source publishes no prices: the price ladder per pack size appears once a priced source is connected.

opportunity.title: Entry opportunity
opportunity.body: The MOS score and the entry brief arrive on Day 4. Until then we show no numbers.

sources.title: Evidence ledger
sources.lead: Every observation behind this sheet, with grade, source, period, run and method version.
sources.empty: No observations are linked to this sheet: the connectors have not loaded data for this cell yet.
sources.filtered: Filter on: {count} observations of one figure
sources.attrBluesky: Public posts from Bluesky (excerpts without authors; not a representative sample)
sources.attrEurostatMod: Derived values (category spending, local demand) are FASTO FTS elaborations of Eurostat and ISTAT data; Eurostat and ISTAT are not responsible for them.

notFound.title: Cell not found
notFound.body: This category and territory combination does not exist in the pilot.
